function object({flag = true, text = 'text'}) {
  const bool: boolean = flag;
  const stringValue: string = text;
  console.log(bool, stringValue);
}
object({});
object({flag: false, text: 'other'});
function tuple([value = 2]) {
  const numberValue: number = value;
  console.log(numberValue);
}
tuple([]);
tuple([5]);
function nested({outer: {key = 3}, inherited: {numberValue} = {numberValue: 4}}) {
  const a: number = key;
  const b: number = numberValue;
  console.log(a, b);
}
nested({outer: {}});
function extra({x = 1, ...rest}) { console.log(x, rest.other); }
extra({other: 6});
function empty([]) { console.log('empty'); }
empty('iterable');
function onlyRest([...args]) { console.log(args.length); }
onlyRest([1, 2]);
function restTuple(...[value = 7]) { console.log(value); }
restTuple();
restTuple(8);
const computed = Symbol();
function withComputed({[computed]: value = 9}) { console.log(value); }
withComputed({});
withComputed({[computed]: 10});
const contextual: (p: {a?: number; b?: number}) => number = ({a = 11, b = a}) => b;
console.log(contextual({}));
